name: Aegisdramon
look: a golden dragon-ship: a long golden hull with a grey armoured deck, a red eye in its prow, flank cannons, white lances bristling forward and silver claws beneath
entry: A golden dragon-ship that guards the deep oceans. Its hull bristles with cannons and lances, and its barrier turns back any attack aimed at the ones it protects.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in beaches, rivers, swamps, mountains and badlands.
